gen-gf-phudu-fs-synonym: Synonym keeps its line plain and unfussy. Phudu brings the loud, distinctive display attitude, and its curves stay generously open beneath a ballpoint-simple stroke.
gen-gf-phudu-outfit: Friendly and clean, the body text bends its strokes like cable and stops its curves short of closing. Outfit would carry a long passage smoothly, with Phudu's bold, open-ended headline shapes sitting above it.
gen-gf-phudu-plus-jakarta-sans: Phudu is bold and distinctive, drawing every curve with an opening and a pressure-free ballpoint line. Plus Jakarta Sans follows in precise monoline, and that shared plainness of stroke is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-phudu-sora: Sora is precise and geometric, with no swell at its corners. Over a long passage its widely parted c and s keep the text moving crisply, a quiet counterpoint to bold, distinctive Phudu above.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-amulya: Amulya reads modern and open, its curve gaps generous. Across a long stretch it stays light and easy on the eye, a plain sans that never competes with the expressive, steady-lined pixel heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-chillax: Relaxed and casual, Chillax draws its line like spaghetti, with curves lifted before the loop closes. Over a long passage that looseness feels easygoing, a soft counterweight to bold, steady Pixelify Sans.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-plein: Neon-tube bold meets quiet reliability. Pixelify Sans is best at loud, expressive headlines with one unvarying line, while Plein is best at clear, clean text, giving each round letter a visible channel in.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-spline-sans: Blocky, bold and loud, with a bent-paperclip c. Spline Sans takes over below with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so the heading's steady line gets a calm, approachable partner on the page.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-synonym: Chunky, expressive and sharply pixelated. Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink with generous curve openings, so a long passage feels dependable and clean after the heading's loud entrance.
